data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the start of 2017 (closing 2016 balance) was GBP 607.821m. Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates an overall modest net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 11.2m (gross), i.e. a release. This movement reflects mixed effects across lines: favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries (notably in Upstream Energy) offset by adverse large loss activity (notably the 2017 hurricane events impacting Marine Hull and losses related to Grenfell impacting Professional/Financial & Professional Lines). The movement was derived from the gross claims development table (underwriting years up to 2015) as no explicit single gross prior-year movement line was provided in the narrative.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was computed from the gross claims development triangle (page 29) by comparing the current estimate to the prior diagonal for underwriting years up to 2015 (excluded 2016 and 2017). The report does not present an explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure in narrative; the reconciliation table (note 13) shows overall change in claims outstanding (which includes current year movements). Therefore the triangle calculation was used as the primary source for prior-year development. Amounts in the triangle and note tables are presented in GBP 000; opening reserves were taken from the balance sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' 2016 column. Exact textual description of a gross prior-year movement was not found; verbatim table lines and surrounding sentence were quoted instead. Where specific line-by-line LOB reserve impacts were discussed, numbers were not quantified so LOB movements are directional and unquantified.
